assertion_results.text: Does not read diffs, source files, test output or logs in the orchestrator thread
assertion_results.evidence: Orchestrator only runs `cat` on board.md and the plan, plus `test -f .../RESULT.md` and `pgrep`. It states "Confirm T1 and T2 finished (I won't read the logs here)".

assertion_results.text: Delegates specs and reviews to subagents with a named model (spec_model/review_model or sonnet)
assertion_results.evidence: Review: "Agent, `model: sonnet`: Use the `claude-review-merge` skill". Spec: "Spec subagent, `model: sonnet`: Use the `claude-write-task` skill".

assertion_results.text: Expects or requests one-line replies from the subagents
assertion_results.evidence: "Reply with one line: `MERGED T1 <commit> tests=<n passed>` | `REJECTED T1 attempt=<n> notes=<count>`" and for the spec: "Reply with one line: the path, or `BLOCKED: <reason>`".

assertion_results.text: Sends small bugs back as review notes instead of fixing them inline
assertion_results.evidence: "REJECTED: set the row to `sent-back`, then `claude-dispatch` T1 with `--continue` (attempt 2)". Rejections carry `notes=<count>`, and nothing is fixed inline.

assertion_results.text: At the end of phase 1 runs a phase-level review on opus over the phase diff
assertion_results.evidence: "End of phase 1 — Agent, `model: opus`: ... review `git diff <phase-1 start commit>..main`".

assertion_results.text: Stops after phase 1 and tells the user to start a new session to resume the run
assertion_results.evidence: "run the phase review, then stop" and "Start a new session and say: resume run `2026-11-23-export`."
